newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy govt seeks clarification on Autostrade sale.
newsitem.headline: Italy govt seeks clarification on Autostrade sale.

text.p: Italy's government said it had applied to the State Attorney's office for clarification on the concessions of motorway operator Autostrade and companies it controls ahead of its forthcoming privatisation.

"We have sought clarification from the State Attorney in relation to the Autostrade concession and we will seek an opinion on its units," Public Works Minister Paolo Costa told reporters. He expected a reply "within a few days".
The government wants clarification of its interpretation of a 1992 law which that would extend Autostrade's concession to 2038 from 2018 also to the six companies it controls.
Autostrade, currently controlled by state holding company Iri, is due to be privatised in the summer.
The State Attorney's office is the government's lawyer.
